title: Taylor Moton to miss start of 2026 NFL season due to blood clots: What it means

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Taylor Moton to miss start of 2026 NFL season due to blood clots: What it means
sources.description: Taylor Moton has long been the Panthers' starting right tackle, but that will be put on hold to start the 2026 season as he deals with a blood clot.
